summary: Baxter International Inc. filed an 8-K on August 4, 2026, announcing cash tender offers to purchase up to $500 million aggregate principal amount of its outstanding senior notes across four series: 3.132% Senior Notes due 2051, 3.500% Senior Notes due 2046, 4.500% Senior Notes due 2043, and 2.539% Senior Notes due 2032. The offers are made pursuant to an Offer to Purchase dated August 4, 2026. The company acts as issuer in this debt repurchase, which reduces outstanding liabilities. Terms include maximum aggregate purchase price of $500 million excluding accrued interest; per-series caps are not specified. The offers are subject to conditions and are not open in jurisdictions where not compliant. Watch for tender results, pricing, and acceptance priority among series.
